weapon_effects.vex: Hitting a target grants Actor advantage on next attack.
weapon_effects.sap: Hitting a target gives target disadvantage on their attacks during their next turn. Sap can only be triggered once per turn, and does not stack.
weapon_effects.slow: Hitting a target reduces target's attack_count by 1 during their next turn. Slow can only be triggered once per turn, and does not stack.
weapon_effects.graze: A missed attacks deal actor's {total_bonus} damage to target
weapon_effects.lifesteal: Hitting a target heals actor for half of total_damage.
weapon_effects.swift: Hitting a target increases actor's attack_count by 1. Swift can only be triggered once per turn, and does not stack.

conditions.stunned: Target skips their turn for {duration} turns
conditions.disadvantage: Actor compares 2 d20 rolls and uses the lesser roll
conditions.advantage: Actor compares 2 d20 rolls and uses the greater roll
conditions.poisoned: Actor has disadvantage on attack rolls
conditions.blinded: Actor has disadvantage on attack rolls and cannot use AoE abilities. Attacks against actor have advantage.
conditions.charmed: Actor can't attack charmer for {duration} turns, ends if charmer attacks you
conditions.frightened: Actor has disadvantage on attacks against source of fear. Source of fear has advantage on attack rolls against actor.
conditions.invisible: Actor can't be seen or targeted, and has advantage on attack rolls. Invisibily ends when actor deals damage.
conditions.paralyzed: Actor is stunned and attack rolls against you have advantage, any hit is a critical hit
conditions.petrified: Actor is stunned and has double AC for {duration} turns. They are turned to stone for the duration (sprite becomes greyscale).
conditions.taunted: Actor must target taunter for {duration} turns.
